title: RodForesight: A World Model Enhanced Diffusion Policy for Slender and Material Agnostic Rod Insertion
description:
arXiv:2609.12103v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Slender rod insertion arises in precision manufacturing, where millimetre scale diameter and tight clearances demand accurate perception and control. Conventional peg-in-hole methods assume a rigid object whose tip pose is fixed relative to the gripper.
